messages:
anya: hey everyone, landed in my first day — quick question: what's the minimal set of people I should ping to get dev laptop, VPN, and repo access. trying to avoid pinging 10 folks. :wave:

devon: welcome! :tada: for laptop + desk -> @mike. for VPN + SSO stuff -> infra team (samir is usually the point). repo access -> @elaine for product repos, and eng-platform for infra repos.

anya: awesome, thanks. do we have a one-line runbook i can bookmark? i keep losing the doc links.

samir: short version: 1) submit the IT form (it.redwood/case) 2) add yourself to the new-hires okta group 3) request repo access via github teams (link in infra README). keep receipts/screenshots and paste them here if anything stalls.

anya: can you paste the git team link?

samir: sure: https://github.com/orgs/redwood/teams/engineers-dev. also if you need private key guidance, ping me — common gotcha is SSH key name collision.

infra-bot: DEPLOYBOT: new hire onboarding checklist created for @anya (ID: 1453). Please follow step prompts.

elaine: for product repos i'll add you today. what's your github handle?

anya: @anya-writescode

elaine: got it — invited to product-core and prompt-lib. you should see email shortly.

mike: i put in an order for a loaner laptop; expect provisioning email by EOD. if you need hardware earlier, reply here.

anya: thx! last thing — escalation path if something is blocked beyond 24h? who do i cc?

devon: good Q. escalate to your hiring manager first (they're cc'd on IT tickets). after 24h ping samir directly and @eng-ops. if it's infra-deploy blocking, add @oncall-eng (rotation) and drop a note in #eng-oncall.

samir: and FYI, for VPN cert delays the SRE oncall can expedite; ping @sre-oncall and reference ticket ID.

anya: perfect, super clear. saving this here for the next new hire too. :)

devon: love that — also add this to the onboarding handbook under 'Seatbelt steps' — who owns that page? @elaine?

elaine: i own the handbook. go ahead and paste a cleaned up version here and i'll slot it in with links and a short flow diagram.

anya: will do later today. thanks everyone! :rocket:
